description: This file defines the ReturnReason controller class within the OpenCart admin module, managing tasks related to return reasons including generating, listing, and clearing JSON language files for return reasons per store and language.

classes.name: ReturnReason
classes.description: Controller class for managing return reason related tasks such as generating task lists, listing return reasons, and clearing generated JSON files in OpenCart admin panel.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Generates a list of tasks to fetch return reasons for each store and language combination.

methods.name: list
methods.description: Generates a JSON file containing return reasons for a specific store and language, saving it to a designated directory.

methods.name: clear
methods.description: Deletes the generated JSON files of return reasons for all configured stores and languages.
